title: Blackbox vibration analyzer in the core
goal: The core analyzes a blackbox log without storing it
acceptance: Before porting, compare NERV's src/blackbox.ts analyser with openbando's existing Blackbox parser (voidbrain/openbando, src/app/core/flight/log-parser.ts and analysis.ts; checkout ~/Projects/openbando) and record the comparison in this step: reuse, or why not. Not a blocks case: neither project imports the other

The F-005 core parses a blackbox CSV and returns the vibration report (axis spectra, motor summary, candidates) with behaviour identical to NERV's src/blackbox.ts, unless the comparison names a difference to keep; it stores nothing; specs carried over from NERV's test/blackbox.test.ts with invented logs
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a 325-line pure module and its test, moved as is; the comparison with openbando's parser added 2026-11-26 (cross-project audit proposal 15, accepted by the owner in chat 2026-11-26 ("accept all 17 proposals"); +0.5 h). Not a measurement.
